Tasks.Read.All.title: Read all users’ tasks and tasklist
Tasks.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read all users’ tasks and task lists in your organization, without a signed-in user.

Tasks.ReadWrite.title: Create, read, update, and delete user’s tasks and task lists
Tasks.ReadWrite.del: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete the signed-in user's tasks and task lists, including any shared with the user.

User.Read.title: Sign in and read user profile
User.Read.del: Allows users to sign-in to the app, and allows the app to read the profile of signed-in users. It also allows the app to read basic company information of signed-in users.

User.ReadBasic.All.title: Read all users' basic profiles
User.ReadBasic.All.app: Allows the app to read a basic set of profile properties of other users in your organization without a signed-in user. Includes display name, first and last name, email address, open extensions, and photo.
User.ReadBasic.All.del: Allows the app to read a basic set of profile properties of other users in your organization on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes display name, first and last name, email address and photo.

User.ReadWrite.title: Read and write access to user profile
User.ReadWrite.del: Allows the app to read your profile. It also allows the app to update your profile information on your behalf.

WindowsUpdates.Read.All.title: Read all Windows update deployment settings
WindowsUpdates.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read all Windows update deployment settings for the organization without a signed-in user.
WindowsUpdates.Read.All.del: Allows the app to read all Windows update deployment settings for the organization on behalf of the signed-in user.

WindowsUpdates.ReadWrite.All.title: Read and write all Windows update deployment settings
WindowsUpdates.ReadWrite.All.app: Allows the app to read and write all Windows update deployment settings for the organization without a signed-in user.
WindowsUpdates.ReadWrite.All.del: Allows the app to read and write all Windows update deployment settings for the organization on behalf of the signed-in user.
